explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/305 with the positive answer (Yokota; Liu–Sawhney): D(b) ≪ b(log b)^{1+o(1)}. D(a,b) is the least bound B admitting distinct positive denominators ≤ B summing to a/b, which equals the minimal largest denominator, and D(b) = max over 1 ≤ a < b. Formal proof linked.
